title: A 19. századi európai regény: Puskintól Tolsztojig
grammar: Social & Psychological Portrayal: Ábrázol, bemutat, tükröz

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name famous 19th-century novels and their authors, from Pushkin to Tolstoy.
I can say briefly what Oliver Twist and War and Peace are about.
I can use verbs of portrayal (*ábrázol*, *bemutat*, *tükröz*) with an object.
I can use words for realism, orphanhood and society.
